card.name: Right before immune-related words
card.fires_on: The spot just before a word starting with "imm" (immature, immunodeficiency, autoimmune, immigrant, immunocompromised), often the "Imm" or "IM" piece itself or the word just ahead of it.

modes.label: Start of imm- words
modes.description: The piece "Imm", "IMM" or "IM" that begins words like immature, immunodeficiency, autoimmune or immigrant.
modes.example: Stem cells become mature blood cells by a process called differentiation.<< Imm>>ature blood cells are called blasts.

modes.label: Word before immune terms
modes.description: A small word or comma right before an expected immune-related word.

card.writes: It pushes toward continuations starting with "im" or "Hum" and suppresses the usual immune/immun spellings.
card.plain: It fires where an immune-type word (immune, immunodeficiency, immigrant) is starting or about to come next.
